results.content: # AI Media & Filmmaking Community | THE ULTIMATE LIST OF A.I | Facebook. THE ULTIMATE LIST OF A.I. TOOLS FOR FILMMAKERS thank you Filmcrux! **SOUNDRAW** - An AI-powered music generation tool that allows you to create custom, royalty-free music for your films and videos. **Synthesia.io** - Easily create videos from text of digital humans that can speak in over 120 languages. **Plask** - A browser animation software and editing tool that lets you create motion capture animations with just your webcam. **Nova.ai** - An AI video editing program that lets you search through the content of your videos using text. **HeyGen** - An AI-powered text-to-video generator that lets you turn any text into a video narrated by a digital human. **Vrew** - An online, AI-powered video editing platform that lets you edit your videos by editing the text. **Pictory** - A cloud-based, AI-powered video editing platform that allows you to edit the videos by editing the text.
